timer_scope: Selected-run function sessions, including model loading, training, checkpoint handling and saving; excludes imports before the timer starts.
worker_timer_scope: Sum of finished_at minus started_at for seven archived Phase 3 worker processes. Includes unsuccessful loading attempts and recovery; not successful GPU optimization-only time or all experiment stages.
caveat: Model-development jobs spanned hours. Forced stops can prevent selected-run function timing from being persisted. The partial function-session total is not an estimate of all training. Neither timer establishes complete training-only time, base-model pretraining time or total project processing time; do not add them together because their scopes can overlap.
